neighbours.label: ' wrote' in a first-person relative clause naming something the speaker authored (an article I wrote, a song I wrote)
fire: Years ago, in a column I wrote for the school paper, I praised the new library.
My grandmother still keeps a poem I wrote when I was seven.
There is a chapter I wrote about this in my first book.
He quoted a blog post I wrote back in 2015.
The band covered a song I wrote during college.
She found an old letter I wrote to her from camp.
The editor rejected the first draft I wrote last spring.
Here is a short guide I wrote for new volunteers.

predictions: ' wrote' after 'I' in 'a/the <work> I wrote' reaches 0.5-0.9; the same frame with another verb (read, received, published) or another subject stays under 0.2.
notes: Probe: 'an essay I wrote' 0.743 vs 'an essay she published' 0.108; 'started writing the novel' 0.174; family nouns weak despite the card ('my son' 0.115, 'her daughter' 0.087). The son/daughter peaks are left uncovered.
